evals.name: b2b-saas-invoicing
evals.prompt: I want to bootstrap a new B2B SaaS for invoice automation — small accounting firms in the US, $49/mo per seat, target $50K MRR in 6 months. Tech stack: Next.js + Convex. Marketing through LinkedIn ads and Google. Set up the project with everything I need to start building.
evals.expected_output: PRD + project scaffolding in docs/ folder (prd.md, tasks.md, planning.md, checkpoint.md) plus CLAUDE.md at root. No native task list machinery. docs/planning.md and CLAUDE.md must reference superpowers workflow.

evals.name: medspa-clinic-mode
evals.prompt: Help me plan a marketing platform for a medspa that does Botox, fillers, and hormone replacement therapy. They want to track leads from Meta and Google ads through to consultation booking and program purchases. Programs range $2K-$15K. HIPAA-compliant. Create the PRD and bootstrap the project.
evals.expected_output: CLINIC MODE PRD with HIPAA considerations, patient journey tracking, program tiers. 4 docs in docs/ + CLAUDE.md at root. Superpowers workflow documented.

evals.name: coaching-booking-platform
evals.prompt: Plan this app: a coaching booking platform where business coaches list their services and clients book 1:1 sessions. Coaches take a 70% revenue cut, platform keeps 30%. Stripe Connect for payouts. Targeting executive coaches first. Build out the requirements doc and project scaffold.
evals.expected_output: Two-sided marketplace PRD with payment integration, booking flow, dashboard. 4 docs in docs/ + CLAUDE.md at root. Superpowers workflow documented.
